inputAssessment: All final groups/checks have identical final source/test/config inventories with no changes during or after execution. Complete workspace rebuilt before tests. Bundled source-map source bytes match current source and vendor files. Historical SQL 1..44 and Runner/dependency files are unchanged.
scope: Local development only: actual file-backed control Workers, accepted T5 and publication transactions, original journal continuation regression, startup/CAS layout and shutdown drain. Physical retirement/fence/route/service/health and upstream source/admission/manual observations remain explicit protocol fixtures. Multi-project concurrency uses an explicit in-process dispatcher over three separate Workers. Superseded history is an explicit metadata projection fixture, not another formal T5. No real model/OIDC/Linux/gVisor/physical provider/data migration or complete successor preserve/replace acceptance. No default physical publisher.
reproduction: validation-driver.mjs records full build/type/lint/contracts and consumer/lifecycle/domain commands, input hashes before/after and stdout/stderr. binding-driver.mjs verifies all final inputs, log hashes, source-map bytes and historical SQL.
actualChecks: Default off, durable storage prerequisite, exact original policy/actor/Runner binding, startup rejection and actual lock/resource release. A later MCP factory failure happens before publication starts.

Actual original T5/PENDING starts publication without Input API or new acceptance entry. Stop closes final authorization, waits for active call, then closes Worker; restart inspects/resumes that same accepted Release.
Published and superseded records do not consume current-work pages; original history remains complete. The successor metadata projection is explicitly not a second formal T5.
Concurrent ticks share one pass and one publish grant. Original accepted facts and historical PENDING acceptance receipt remain unchanged after publication.
Grant and observation ACKs are discarded after actual private Worker commits. Reopened Worker recovers without replaying publish.
Periodic UNKNOWN route continuation uses inspect/resume on the same original Release; absence of resume stays UNKNOWN. Disabled backend skips scans/effects.
Stop during preflight/publish/inspect/resume drains real promises. Preflight cannot dispatch after stop; publish/resume final authorization returns false; inspect does not begin resume after stop.
Explicit dispatcher over three actual Workers verifies scope rotation, at most two unfinished backend calls and progress despite one scan failure.
Existing domain regression covers original publication proof/gate transactions and Runner stage continuation, with existing acceptance-consumer and foundation lifecycle regressions.
limits: Physical retirement/fence/route/service/health and upstream source/admission/manual observations are explicit protocol fixtures.
Superseded history uses explicit metadata projection, not another formal successor T5.
No actual model, enterprise OIDC, Linux/gVisor, physical provider or data migration acceptance.
Backend interfaces cannot forcibly cancel a non-returning adapter; drain remains pending. Adapters own bounded I/O, external resources are caller-owned.
Full pnpm check and fixed-commit clean-checkout validation were not run.
